title: Payment before joining
text: Legitimate internships and jobs do not charge candidates for selection, registration, onboarding, LMS access, training kits or security deposits. A payment demand before joining is the strongest scam indicator.

title: LMS dues pattern
text: A common pattern: the candidate is told they are selected, then asked to pay dues, an access fee or a refundable deposit to unlock an LMS or training portal. Promised refunds are rarely honoured.
key: dues, an access fee or a refundable deposit

title: Artificial urgency
text: Scam offers pressure candidates with short deadlines such as pay within 24 hours or the seat is cancelled.
key: pay within 24 hours or the seat is cancelled

title: Chat-app-only contact
text: Offers that arrive only through WhatsApp or Telegram, with no corporate email, interview or assessment, are a red flag.

title: Free email domains
text: Recruiters who write from free email domains such as gmail, outlook or yahoo while claiming to represent a registered company deserve extra verification.

title: No interview, high stipend
text: Selection without any interview, test or resume review is a warning sign, especially with an unusually high stipend or guaranteed placement.

title: Guaranteed certificates
text: Guaranteed certificates and job-guarantee claims attached to paid courses are a red flag. Verify the issuer on its official website and check for verifiable certificate IDs or QR codes.

title: Verify the company
text: Check the company in the official MCA company database, look at how old its website domain is, and confirm the recruiter on LinkedIn before sharing anything.

title: What genuine offers look like
text: Genuine offers usually name a hiring manager, come from a corporate email domain, describe the role clearly and never request payment at any stage.

title: Early document requests
text: Requests for Aadhaar, PAN, bank details or OTPs before a formal offer letter is signed are a red flag. Share ID documents only after verifying the employer.
key: Aadhaar, PAN, bank details or OTPs
